title: How long should your resume be?
description:
It’s easy to get caught up in resume length but it’s doesn’t much AS MUCH as the content on it. You really don’t want a super long resume but what you want to think about first is on adding in content that is relevant. Your old job from college that doesn’t matter anymore to your career can be removed. #resume #resumetips #resumeadvice #resumetiktok #resumetok #resumebullets #jobseeker #jobseekers

transcript: the length of your resume really doesn't matter what's a lot more important than like a onepage resume is whether or not the content on it is relevant it's kind of old resume advice that you should put everything you've ever done on it don't do that anymore and how you want to do this is when you find a job that you want to apply to look at the job description see what the company is looking for then with your resume make sure that every bullet every job and every skill you have listed is relevant to that information if it's not just take it off naturally this will lead to a shorter resume but more importantly it means that everything on your resume that a hiring manager reads is relevant and is working towards helping you get that interview
